subject: Crowd at a Kamala Harris rally at Detroit Metro Airport, Aug. 7, 2024
called_fake_by: Donald Trump, then the Republican nominee
claim: Trump posted that a photo of the large crowd was AI-generated and that nobody was actually there.
finding: The Harris campaign said a staffer took the photo and that AI wasn't used to make or modify it. News outlets had their own photos and video of the same crowd. Image-forensics expert Hany Farid found no sign of AI generation. PolitiFact rated the claim Pants on Fire.
outcome: The claim circulated widely among supporters. News organizations that covered the rally published their own photos and video of the crowd, and fact-checkers pointed to that coverage and to Farid's analysis.

sources.title: Donald Trump is wrong. These images of Kamala Harris' Aug. 7 Detroit rally are corroborated, not AI.
Why false claims that a picture of a Kamala Harris rally was AI-generated matter
